qualification: Candidates applying for the Assistant Manager or Sr. Executive/Executive Land Acquisition and R&R posts must have a full-time postgraduate degree in MSW, or Master of Social Work, from a Government-recognised University or Institute.
salary: For Assistant Manager, candidates from Government, PSU or Metro Rail organisations are required to meet the pay-scale conditions specified in the notification. || Candidates may presently be working in the revised IDA scale of ₹50,000–1,60,000 or an equivalent CDA scale in Government, PSU or Metro Rail Corporation. || Alternatively, candidates should have worked for at least two years in the revised IDA pay scale of ₹46,000–1,45,000 in a Non-Executive grade, ₹40,000–1,40,000 in an Executive grade, or Level 6 under the 7th CPC in Government, PSU or Metro Rail Corporation. || Another permitted condition is at least four years in the revised IDA pay scale of ₹40,000–1,25,000 in a Non-Executive grade, ₹35,000–1,10,000 in an Executive grade, or equivalent CDA scale. || Applicants from the private sector should have a minimum CTC of ₹70,000 per month.
age_limit: Age and experience will be calculated as on 3 October 2026. || The notification states that the age limit will not apply to GMRCL employees. However, this age relaxation does not apply to officials re-employed in GMRCL after superannuation.
application_fee: The available GMRC recruitment notification does not mention an application fee for these posts.
selection_process: The official notification identifies Personal Interview, Document Verification and Medical Examination as the selection components. It also separately states that document verification of candidates will be conducted before the interview and that candidates must carry their original certificates. || Document Verification || Personal Interview || Medical Examination as prescribed for the post || The interview process will assess knowledge, skills, experience, expertise, aptitude and physical fitness. The date, time and venue will be communicated to shortlisted applicants in advance. Interview call letters will be sent through the registered email address.
